notes.title: Update v1.0.8
notes.content:
* Add custom hand cursor
* Fix weirdness where you could hold down mouse button and get unwanted veggie throws
* Add full, proper fade-to-black

notes.title: Watch MopGarden play MopGarden's Veggie Cart!
notes.content:
She's really good at it! This is pre-recorded from when she played the game on November 30, 2022.

Check out MopGarden herself at https://twitch.tv/mopgarden.

notes.title: v1.0.7-2
notes.content: - Accidentally published the last changes as a development build - sorry!

notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
- Fix bug where game freezes if user restarts a level that has tutorial screens
- Make “click and flick” gestures easier, especially on desktop
- Mask reveal now starts by showing a bit of the vegetable, to increase fairness on faster levels

notes.title: MopGarden's Veggie Cart - Available Now!
notes.content:
The wait is over - MopGarden's Veggie Cart is live and ready to be played! It's free, and available here on Steam, and also here:

🍎 iPhone / iPad: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/mopgardens-veggie-cart/id6443608537
🤖 Android phones / tablets: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.patientcactus.mopgardensveggiecart

I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it. <3

And of course, don't forget to check out [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mopgarden]MopGarden herself[/url].

1000Nettles / Corey

notes.title: MopGarden's Veggie Cart available on November 30th!
notes.content:
At 9am on November 30th, we will be flipping the switch to push MopGarden's Veggie Cart live on Steam! (And, on the Apple App Store and Google Play if that's your jam.) For those links, please see [url=mopgardensveggiecart.com]mopgardensveggiecart.com[/url] when the game launches...

One week away! Tell your friends, your grandma(s), your pets, and especially your mailman. Thanks and I'll see you on the 30th!

And, of course, don't forget to check out MopGarden herself on Twitch! https://www.twitch.tv/mopgarden

1000Nettles / Corey
